mailkeep.notes:
# Mailkeep 0.3.10 - Categories, Collapsible Side Nav & Smart Filters

### Features
- Dedicated Gmail Categories Section: Grouped server-assigned Gmail category labels (Personal, Social, Promotions, Updates, Forums) into their own collapsible Categories section with clean icons and human-friendly display names.
- Collapsible Side Menu: Added expand and collapse toggles for Folders, Categories, Tags, and Labels in the side navigation drawer, including nested label hierarchy collapsing with persistent state.
- Accurate Total and Unread Counts: Side navigation drawer now displays unread count badges alongside total email counts for every folder, category, and label, kept up-to-date with parallel background refreshes.
- All Inboxes Multi-Account Sync & Pagination: All Inboxes now coordinates syncing across all signed-in accounts, calculates aggregate server counts, and provides a Load More emails button for paginating large folders.
- Advanced Filter Creation Directly from Email: Added Filter emails like this action to the message reader with prefilled sender domain and subject, inline new label creation, retroactive execution on existing emails, and zero-cost on-device AI Smart Suggestions.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed All Inboxes showing only 5 cached messages when thousands existed across inboxes.
- Hid empty legacy CHAT system folder to prevent confusing immutable system folder warnings.
- Fixed side drawer scroll position jumping to the top when labels updated or deletions occurred.

routerwarden.notes:
Router Warden 1.1.0 - Smoother updates

### Features
- Update downloads can be paused, resumed from where they stopped, stopped, and retried after a network drop.
- Old update files are deleted automatically after an update installs.

### Bug fixes
- The release signing key is pinned in the repo, so updates built on any machine install over this version.
